title: Lumenvale Water · Network Operations
description: Supply, storage, losses, water quality and pumping for a fictional 21 000-connection utility

targets.rawSql:
-- KPI · System demand
-- Hourly plant outflow for the 48 h before the end of the range.
-- The panel shows the latest hour, compares it with the same hour
-- yesterday and draws the last 24 h as a sparkline.
SELECT date_bin('1 hour', r.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS "time",
       round(avg(r.value)::numeric, 1)                     AS demand_m3h
FROM ops.reading r
JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE s.tag = 'PLANT.OUTFLOW'
  AND r.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours'
  AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · Non-revenue water
-- Daily system input vs billed volume over the last 30 closed days.
-- NRW = water put into the network that never reached a bill
-- (leaks + meter under-registration + unbilled use).
WITH input AS (
    SELECT r.ts::date AS day, sum(r.value) * 0.25 AS input_m3      -- 15-min m3/h -> m3
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
    WHERE s.kind = 'flow' AND s.asset_type = 'dma'
      AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '30 days'
      AND r.ts <  date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)
    GROUP BY 1
),
billed AS (
    SELECT day, sum(billed_m3) AS billed_m3
    FROM ops.billed_daily
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT i.day::timestamptz                                   AS "time",
       round(i.input_m3::numeric, 0)                        AS input_m3,
       round(b.billed_m3, 0)                                AS billed_m3,
       round((100 * (i.input_m3 - b.billed_m3) / i.input_m3)::numeric, 2) AS nrw_pct
FROM input i
JOIN billed b USING (day)
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · Pumping energy intensity (kWh per m3 pumped), last 30 days
WITH d AS (
    SELECT r.ts::date AS day, s.kind, sum(r.value) * 0.25 AS total
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
    WHERE s.asset_type = 'pump_station'
      AND s.kind IN ('flow', 'power')
      AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '30 days'
      AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT day::timestamptz AS "time",
       round((max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'power')
            / nullif(max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'flow'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS kwh_per_m3,
       round(max(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'power')::numeric, 0)            AS kwh
FROM d
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY 1;

-- KPI · Active alarms (refId A): open alarms by severity at the end of the range
SELECT severity,
       count(*)                                   AS active,
       min(raised_at)                             AS oldest
FROM ops.alarm
WHERE raised_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (cleared_at IS NULL OR cleared_at > $__timeTo()::timestamptz)
GROUP BY severity;

-- KPI · Active alarms (refId B): hourly count of open alarms, last 7 days
SELECT h AS "time",
       count(a.alarm_id) AS active
FROM generate_series(date_trunc('hour', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '7 days',
                     date_trunc('hour', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), interval '1 hour') AS h
LEFT JOIN ops.alarm a
       ON a.raised_at <= h AND (a.cleared_at IS NULL OR a.cleared_at > h)
GROUP BY h
ORDER BY h;

-- Production & storage
-- Plant outflow vs total storage (capacity-weighted level of all
-- reservoirs). Storage should fall during the day and recover overnight.
WITH b AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '3 days'
                THEN interval '15 minutes' ELSE interval '1 hour' END AS step
),
outflow AS (
    SELECT date_bin(b.step, r.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS t, avg(r.value) AS q
    FROM ops.reading r JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id), b
    WHERE s.tag = 'PLANT.OUTFLOW' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)
    GROUP BY 1
),
storage AS (
    SELECT date_bin(b.step, r.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS t,
           sum(r.value / 100 * rv.capacity_m3) / count(DISTINCT r.ts)    AS stored_m3,
           100 * sum(r.value / 100 * rv.capacity_m3) / sum(rv.capacity_m3) AS stored_pct
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s    USING (sensor_id)
    JOIN ops.reservoir rv ON rv.reservoir_id = s.asset_id, b
    WHERE s.kind = 'level' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.t                                AS "time",
       round(o.q::numeric, 1)             AS outflow_m3h,
       round(st.stored_pct::numeric, 1)   AS storage_pct,
       round(st.stored_m3::numeric, 0)    AS storage_m3
FROM outflow o
JOIN storage st USING (t)
ORDER BY 1;

-- Reservoir storage: latest level of every reservoir, its operating band
-- and the level 24 h earlier (for the trend arrow)
SELECT rv.reservoir_id,
       rv.name,
       rv.capacity_m3,
       rv.low_level_pct,
       rv.high_level_pct,
       cur.value  AS level_pct,
       prev.value AS level_24h_ago_pct
FROM ops.reservoir rv
JOIN ops.sensor s ON s.asset_id = rv.reservoir_id AND s.kind = 'level'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT value FROM ops.reading
    WHERE sensor_id = s.sensor_id AND ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
) cur ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT value FROM ops.reading
    WHERE sensor_id = s.sensor_id AND ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '24 hours'
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
) prev ON true
ORDER BY rv.capacity_m3 DESC;

-- Demand pattern: average plant outflow by weekday x hour of day
SELECT extract(isodow FROM r.ts)::int AS weekday,      -- 1 = Monday
       extract(hour   FROM r.ts)::int AS hour,
       round(avg(r.value)::numeric, 0) AS demand_m3h
FROM ops.reading r
JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE s.tag = 'PLANT.OUTFLOW'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

-- Minimum night flow by DMA
-- Average 02:00-04:00 inflow over the last 7 nights vs the 7 nights
-- before and vs the DMA's baseline. Night flow is the classic leak
-- indicator: almost nobody uses water at 3 am, so what flows is mostly loss.
WITH night AS (
    SELECT s.asset_id AS dma_id,
           r.ts,
           r.value
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
    WHERE s.asset_type = 'dma' AND s.kind = 'flow'
      AND extract(hour FROM r.ts) BETWEEN 2 AND 3
      AND r.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '14 days'
      AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
)
SELECT d.dma_id,
       d.name,
       d.connections,
       d.baseline_mnf_m3h,
       round(avg(n.value) FILTER (WHERE n.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days')::numeric, 2) AS mnf_7d_m3h,
       round(avg(n.value) FILTER (WHERE n.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days')::numeric, 2) AS mnf_prev_7d_m3h
FROM ops.dma d
JOIN night n USING (dma_id)
GROUP BY d.dma_id, d.name, d.connections, d.baseline_mnf_m3h
ORDER BY (avg(n.value) FILTER (WHERE n.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days')) / d.baseline_mnf_m3h DESC;

-- Chlorine residual by pressure zone (hourly mean)
-- Target band 0.3-0.8 mg/l is drawn by the panel.
SELECT date_bin('1 hour', r.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS "time",
       round(avg(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.asset_id = 'Z-NORTH')::numeric, 3)   AS north,
       round(avg(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.asset_id = 'Z-CENTRAL')::numeric, 3) AS central,
       round(avg(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.asset_id = 'Z-SOUTH')::numeric, 3)   AS south,
       round(avg(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.asset_id = 'Z-EAST')::numeric, 3)    AS east
FROM ops.reading r
JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE s.kind = 'chlorine'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- Pump stations: live status, load, efficiency and a 24 h flow sparkline
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.asset_id, s.kind)
           s.asset_id AS station_id, s.kind, r.value
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
    WHERE s.asset_type = 'pump_station'
      AND r.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 hour'
      AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY s.asset_id, s.kind, r.ts DESC
),
energy AS (
    SELECT s.asset_id AS station_id,
           sum(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'power' AND r.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days')
         / nullif(sum(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'flow' AND r.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'), 0)  AS kwh_m3_7d,
           sum(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'power' AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days')
         / nullif(sum(r.value) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'flow' AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'), 0) AS kwh_m3_prev,
           100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'flow' AND r.value > 0 AND r.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '24 hours')
                 / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'flow' AND r.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '24 hours'), 0)   AS runtime_24h_pct
    FROM ops.reading r
    JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
    WHERE s.asset_type = 'pump_station'
      AND r.ts >  $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '14 days'
      AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
),
spark AS (
    SELECT station_id, json_agg(round(q::numeric, 0) ORDER BY h)::text AS flow_24h
    FROM (
        SELECT s.asset_id AS station_id,
               date_bin('1 hour', r.ts, timestamptz '2000-01-01') AS h,
               avg(r.value) AS q
        FROM ops.reading r
        JOIN ops.sensor s USING (sensor_id)
        WHERE s.asset_type = 'pump_station' AND s.kind = 'flow'
          AND r.ts > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '24 hours' AND r.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) x
    GROUP BY station_id
),
open_alarm AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id AS station_id, severity, message
    FROM ops.alarm
    WHERE raised_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND (cleared_at IS NULL OR cleared_at > $__timeTo()::timestamptz)
    ORDER BY asset_id, CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'major' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
)
SELECT p.station_id,
       p.name,
       CASE WHEN a.severity = 'critical'          THEN 'tripped'
            WHEN coalesce(f.value, 0) = 0         THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN a.severity IS NOT NULL           THEN 'warning'
            ELSE 'running' END                             AS status,
       a.message                                           AS alarm,
       round(coalesce(f.value, 0)::numeric, 0)             AS flow_m3h,
       round((100 * coalesce(f.value, 0) / p.rated_flow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS load_pct,
       round(e.kwh_m3_7d::numeric, 3)                      AS kwh_m3,
       round(e.kwh_m3_prev::numeric, 3)                    AS kwh_m3_prev,
       round(e.runtime_24h_pct::numeric, 0)                AS runtime_24h_pct,
       sp.flow_24h
FROM ops.pump_station p
LEFT JOIN latest f      ON f.station_id = p.station_id AND f.kind = 'flow'
LEFT JOIN energy e      ON e.station_id = p.station_id
LEFT JOIN spark sp      ON sp.station_id = p.station_id
LEFT JOIN open_alarm a  ON a.station_id = p.station_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.severity = 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN a.severity IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.station_id;
